_comment: cmd.c doterrain() 1153-1164: when the player toggles off the preselected 'known map without monsters, objects, and traps' entry and then commits the menu, select_menu() returns 0 and doterrain() still shows the known map (which = 1). A Samurai in normal play opens #terrain, presses '-' to unselect every entry, commits with Return, then leaves the terrain view. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
